name: smwmusic-fire-emblem-the-sacred-stones-distant-roads
title: Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones - Distant Roads
description:
Theme for the first few maps of Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones. Suitable for grassland levels.

The MML file is cross-compiled from a different MML dialect using a custom Lua script, and then manually optimized.
